name: Margarita
workoutDescription:
This benchmark is a 20-minute test of explosive power and cardiovascular endurance, divided into four 5-minute blocks.

Part 1: Cardio Blast (5 Minutes)
Perform as many rounds as possible (AMRAP) in 5 minutes of:
* 10 Burpees
* 15 Kettlebell Swings (Moderate weight, chest height)

Part 2: Heavy Squat Clean (5 Minutes)
Establish a 1-Rep Max (1RM) Back Squat Clean. You have 5 minutes to warm up and find your heaviest successful lift. Rest as needed between attempts.

Part 3: Cardio Blast (5 Minutes)
Repeat Part 1: AMRAP in 5 minutes of:
* 10 Burpees
* 15 Russian Kettlebell Swings (Moderate weight, chest height)

Part 4: Heavy Snatch (5 Minutes)
Establish a 1-Rep Max (1RM) Snatch. You have 5 minutes to warm up and find your heaviest successful lift. Rest as needed between attempts.
